raw.query: WITH latest_attention_ledger AS (SELECT le.id, le.raw, (regexp_match(le.raw, 'attention ([0-9.]+)→([0-9.]+) ms/img'))[2]::double precision AS collected_ms FROM provenance.ledger_entry le WHERE le.name ILIKE 'Kernel ledgers N=1/N=64%' ORDER BY le.id DESC LIMIT 1), measured AS (SELECT kl.ms AS measured_ms FROM provenance.collector_kernel_ledger kl WHERE kl.source_path LIKE '%/phaseB_batch_validation/kernel_ledger_N1.json' AND kl.entry_kind = 'category' AND kl.entry_name = 'attention'), supersession AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_supersessions FROM provenance.metric_supersession ms WHERE ms.metric ILIKE '%attention%' AND (ms.superseded_run_id = 'collector:kernel_ledger_N1' OR ms.current_run_id = 'collector:kernel_ledger_N1')) SELECT measured.measured_ms, latest_attention_ledger.collected_ms, ROUND((ABS(latest_attention_ledger.collected_ms - measured.measured_ms) / measured.measured_ms * 100)::numeric, 3) AS absolute_difference_pct, supersession.n_supersessions FROM latest_attention_ledger CROSS JOIN measured CROSS JOIN supersession
raw.observed: measured attention 1.300 ms/img; collected attention 1.306 ms/img; absolute difference 0.462%; 0 supersessions
raw.evidence: Refuter mimo-v2.5 incorrectly evaluated whole-encoder latency mismatch from collector_encoder_fn (25-62% deviation) as attention operator latency; the isolated attention kernel itself is measured at 1.300 ms/img and collected at 1.306 ms/img, which differs by 0.462%, fully supporting the claim of ≈3% agreement.
